buildProvenance.scope: existing workflow provenance with commit and run metadata

pathResolution: These paths are relative to the deployment SITE ROOT, not to /research/v1/. Resolve from the page root, for example new URL('.', document.baseURI), before appending the path.
purpose: Read-only area-research atlas for selecting where to investigate next. It is not a booking, operating, investment, legal, licensing, or suitability decision.

canonicalBoundaries.boundaryVintage: Every feature properties.boundary_date exactly equals index.boundary and automation.registry.boundaryVintage.
canonicalBoundaries.labelAliases: Join by the eight-digit code only. Display spelling must match the boundary or one reviewed code-specific, vintage-specific name pair (seven middle-dot variants, two 상일제N동 variants). Never join by normalized name.

units.area: one 8-digit administrative dong; never a property, listing, host, guest, account, or raw source record
units.current04: estimated daily mean short-stay foreign population present at 04:00, persons
units.registrations: operating foreign-tourist urban homestay registrations, count
units.inflowDaily: estimated cross-dong movement events/day, not people
units.nightPurposePct: share of 00:00–05:59 arrivals among short-term arrivals in the purpose dataset, percent
units.subwayTransportPct: subway share in the transport dataset, percent
units.innQuarterKrw: estimated inn-industry quarterly amount, KRW; not Airbnb revenue

nullAndZero.null: not supplied, incomplete, invalid, period-mismatched, or intentionally withheld; never replace with zero
nullAndZero.zero: a measured or published zero and remains zero
nullAndZero.eligible: true only when all classification inputs are valid and complete
nullAndZero.insufficient: eligible=false; all gates are null; missing explains the held-out classification
nullAndZero.context: contextual values may be null without changing eligibility
nullAndZero.thresholds: levelMedian, baseQ25, and registryMedian are null only with no eligible areas; positiveGainMedian is null when no eligible area has a strictly positive delta

thresholdAlgorithm.population: Eligible areas are exactly areas with a presence row, registry row, nonnegative current04, strictly positive previous04, complete expected calendar days in both compared periods, valid official changePct, and nonnegative integer registrations.
thresholdAlgorithm.denominators: All medians and the base quartile use the eligible-area set only. positiveGainMedian uses only eligible areas whose delta04=current04-previous04 is strictly greater than zero.
thresholdAlgorithm.levelMedian: Median current04: sorted middle value for odd n; arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even n.
thresholdAlgorithm.baseQ25: Nearest-rank first quartile previous04: sorted value at one-based rank ceil(0.25*n).
thresholdAlgorithm.positiveGainMedian: Median of strictly positive eligible delta04 values, using the same odd/even median rule.
thresholdAlgorithm.registryMedian: Median registrations across eligible areas, using the same odd/even median rule.
thresholdAlgorithm.tiers: field: level, base, gain, lowRegistration all true. peer: level, base, gain true and lowRegistration false. watch: eligible otherwise. insufficient: ineligible. A zero field count is valid.

sourceRequirements.periods: OA-23018 must equal the current comparison YYYY-MM; OA-22379, OA-22378, and OA-22656 must equal their included YYYY-MM period; OA-22175 must equal its included YYYYQn sales period.

allowed: filter and navigate using documented fragments
humanReview: check nulls, missing fields, periods, boundaries, and source provenance
test the counterpoint against local field evidence
separate confidence in an observed measure from confidence in the next action

reproducibility.genericExample: Fetch the same deployment's research/v1/index.json, select an area by code, verify href equals #view=decision&lens=where&dong={code}, then reproduce its tier from values, thresholds, gates, missing, and sources in that response.
reproducibility.determinism: The endpoint documents are recreated for every development request, build, CI run, or data refresh from local buffers only. They use no clock or network input.
